lines.zh: 我一步跨两级台阶，骨头在响。
lines.en: I take the stairs two at a time, bones creaking.
My bones are a size thicker than a man's.
I cross the grass and it does not move.
My feet land with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 我没有肉，走起来却比人快。
lines.en: No flesh, yet I walk faster than a man.
I roll my shoulders as I walk.

lines.zh: 我沿着大路走，去找活的。
lines.en: I take the road, hunting for the living.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方有骨头摩擦声。
lines.en: A sound of bone on bone follows me.

lines.zh: 我一步一步逼近，声音很响。
lines.en: I close in step by step, loudly.
When I turn, my ribs rattle.
I walk toward the house with lights on.
I do not hide. I come straight on.

lines.zh: 我站着，下巴的骨头在动。
lines.en: I stand, my jawbone working.
My eye sockets are empty, but I am not blind.

lines.zh: 我的骨头里有一点点风。
lines.en: There is a little wind inside my bones.
I grip an old bone.
I listen for breathing nearby.
I tilt my head; my neck clicks.
Rags hang from me.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一堆遗骨。
lines.en: I hold still, like a pile of remains.

lines.zh: 我知道活人在地面上走动。
lines.en: I know the living walk above.
I wait for the lamp inside to go out.
You have flesh. Good.
I stand a head and a half above you.
You stand there. I see you clearly.
I raise a hand and the bones crack.
Are you planning to run?
One fist of mine could wrap your whole face.
I remember being a person once.
I do not remember it well.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，我隔着肋骨架听见。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat through my ribs.

lines.zh: 我向前挪了一步，骨头响。
lines.en: I shift one step forward, bones creaking.
A rib came loose.

lines.zh: 我被敲得晃了一下骨架。
lines.en: The blow rattled my whole frame.
I feel no pain, only irritation.
One bone has slipped out of place.

lines.zh: 这一下，打掉了我一块骨片。
lines.en: That knocked off a chip of bone.
I straighten my frame again.
A good hit. A pity it does not hurt.
I lower my head to look at the gap.
I can still walk with this damage.
This pile has not come apart yet.
This skeleton has no appetite.
You show food to bones.
No tongue in this mouth.
I have no use for it.
Put the bowl down and go.
Your flesh has more chew to it than bread.
Holding that, you cannot guard yourself.
I forgot taste long ago.
Keep it for yourself.

lines.zh: 我不是饿，我是想拆东西。
lines.en: It is not hunger. I want to break things.
You hit my ribs and fell back.
My bones have no skin and are hard.
Move. I am walking through.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，骨头硌得你发麻。
lines.en: You hit me; my bones leave your arm numb.
I shifted slightly.
You were knocked back a few steps.

lines.zh: 地上的灰被我们扬起来。
lines.en: We raised dust from the ground.
Do not walk against my ribs.
My bones are sharp.
Again, and I use my fist.
I am only a pile of bones.
That ended long ago.
There are many companions in the grave.
I have no warmth to give.
Do not say that to a pile of bones.
I remember there was someone.
She has been gone a long while.
I only want to keep walking.
You asked the wrong thing.
I am going to find the living.
I pick up a bone.
This bone is about as thick as mine.

lines.zh: 这分量，我一根指骨就够。
lines.en: This weight is nothing for one finger bone.
I tuck it into my waist.
I can lift this iron.
It slipped through my fingers.
I throw it aside.
Whose hand bone is this.
I carry it two steps.
I crush it.

lines.zh: 你的鞋在地上蹭了一下。
lines.en: Your boot scraped the floor.
I turn my frame to face you.
Two steps at this distance.
I raise my fist.
Your heart suddenly got louder.

lines.zh: 这里的门太小，你出不去。
lines.en: That door is too narrow. You cannot get out.
I advance, bones rattling.
I never need to dodge.
You stand steady — a fine target.
I will strike first. Do not wait.
I remember this motion.
I have not thrown this punch in a long time.
Your weapon is held too low.
My bones have memorized your position.
Nothing behind you now but wall.
I lift my foot; my shadow arrives first.

lines.zh: 眨眼的一瞬，我的拳就到。
lines.en: In the blink of an eye, my fist arrives.

lines.zh: 你走多快，骨头就跟多快。
lines.en: However fast you walk, my bones keep pace.
Wherever you run, I hear you.
My bones are light. I walk fast.
I fill the doorway. Nothing gets out.
You circle a pillar; so do I.
No lungs. I can wait forever.
You stepped on bones.
That sound is my knuckles.
You stepped on loose bones — far too loud.
I knocked the table over.

lines.zh: 墙根下，你的退路到头了。
lines.en: At the base of the wall, your retreat ends.
Each breath you take, I count it.
Behind you is a dead end.
I raise my hand and my shadow covers you.
Your strength is dwindling.
I never need to catch my breath. Can you say the same?
There are not many living here.
The stairwell is narrow enough for me to block.
I will go down and wait.
You should not have looked back.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，地板裂了。
lines.en: My fist comes down and the floor cracks.
After this, your bones will ring.
I grab; my nails are bone.
My fist is heavy.
You blocked it and still fell back.

lines.zh: 我一手压住你，墙在背后。
lines.en: I pin you with one hand, the wall at your back.

lines.zh: 这一击，带着骨头的重量。
lines.en: This blow carries the weight of bone.
You fly out and knock over a chair.
I drive an elbow down.
I do not feel fatigue.
This fist should bring you to your knees.
I hang my foot above your head.

lines.zh: 我的骨头撞在你身上，很响。
lines.en: My bones strike you loudly.
I did not hold back.
I will not chase; I will just wait for you to come back.
Good dodge — here comes another.

lines.zh: 我从土里翻出来，先露出头骨。
lines.en: I claw out of the earth, skull first.

lines.zh: 身上的土一块块掉下去。
lines.en: Clods of soil fall off me.

lines.zh: 我撑起身体，骨头一节节对上。
lines.en: I push up and my bones line up joint by joint.
The first thing I see is night.
My finger bones flex once.
No flesh. It is lighter this way.
I remember lying down a long time.

lines.zh: 我站起来，比我以为的高。
lines.en: I stand up. Taller than I expected.
There is the smell of the living.

lines.zh: 土里先冒出来的是我的手。
lines.en: My hand comes out of the soil first.
My bones are still settling.
I raise a hand, joints locking.
I have been here before.
Now I only remember to fight.

lines.zh: 火苗舔上我的肋骨，焦了。
lines.en: Flames lick my ribs and scorch them.

lines.zh: 落地时，我几节脊椎错位了。
lines.en: On landing, several of my vertebrae slipped out of line.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的胸腔，我沉了。
lines.en: Water fills my chest and I sink.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，骨头飞了。
lines.en: The blast flips me and bones fly.
An arrow wedges in my collarbone.
A curse slips into my bones, cold.
I am not hungry, but my bones grow brittle.
Lightning passes through; my bones light up.

lines.zh: 地下没有土，我一直在落。
lines.en: No soil below; I keep falling.
